label: EF as a least fixpoint
subgoals: Start from the set of q-states
Add every state with a successor in the current set
Stop at the first i where the set repeats

label: EG as a greatest fixpoint
subgoals: Start from the set of p-states
Remove the states with no successor in the current set
Stop at the first i where the set repeats

label: Until and the lattice argument
subgoals: Start from the set of q-states
Add the p-states with a successor in the current set
Stop at the first i where the set repeats, at most the number of states
